name: Seal Chat
notes: Linked devices: use one Seal Chat ID on several computers — contacts can reach you at any of them (Settings → Your devices → Link a new device…)
Your devices keep each other up to date: messages, contacts, reads, reactions, your name and picture
Contacts on 1.9 try your other addresses when one doesn't answer

web.note: Replies and reactions on the phone, the mailbox, and name@yourdomain names (admin.php → Names)
